prompt: Why run `go test` in `golang:1.25` rather than with whatever Go a machine has installed?

choices.text: Tests are faster in a container
choices.why: Speed is not the argument.

choices.text: Go refuses to run tests outside a container
choices.why: It runs them anywhere; the version differs.

choices.text: The image includes the tests
choices.why: The source is mounted; the image only brings the toolchain.

choices.text: Every machine then tests with the same Go
choices.why: Right: 1.25.14, here and in the pipeline.

prompt: To stop Go from reusing a cached test result, add `-count=___`.
A plain `docker build -t shelf:1.7.0 .` showed no `[test …]` step. Why?
hint: What does the final stage copy from?

choices.text: The final stage needs nothing from `test`
choices.why: Right: only stages the target needs are run.

choices.text: BuildKit skips stages named `test`
choices.why: The name means nothing; the graph decides.

choices.text: The tests were cached from the run just before
choices.why: A cached step is still listed, as `CACHED`.

choices.text: Tests run only when the build is given `--no-cache`
choices.why: They ran with `--target test`, cache and all.

prompt: With `/health` answering `OK`, `docker build --target test .` exited with status 1. What does a pipeline do with that?
hint: What did the build not produce?

choices.text: It retries until the test passes
choices.why: A deterministic failure fails again.

choices.text: It stops: no image is built from the failing code
choices.why: Right, which is the point of the stage.

choices.text: It pushes the image with a warning
choices.why: There is no image to push.

choices.text: It ignores it, as tests are optional in builds
choices.why: Status 1 is a failure to any pipeline.

prompt: Why is a test that talks to a database a poor fit for a `RUN` step in the Dockerfile?
hint: When does a cached step run again?

choices.text: Dockerfiles cannot run `go test` inside a `RUN` step at all
choices.why: The test stage ran it.

choices.text: Databases are not allowed in builds
choices.why: The issue is caching, not permission.

choices.text: Its result depends on more than the files the cache sees
choices.why: Right: an unchanged step prints `CACHED`, database or not.

choices.text: The test stage has no Go
choices.why: It starts from `build`, which has Go.

prompt: Order what happens for `docker build --target test .`.
hint: Follow the graph from the bottom.
items: Copy the modules and the source

prompt: Why does the test database keep its data on a `tmpfs`?
hint: What should the next run start from?

choices.text: Postgres requires it in containers
choices.why: Lesson 19 used a named volume.

choices.text: To keep the test password secret
choices.why: The password is in the file anyway.

choices.text: So that `down -v` is never needed afterwards
choices.why: That is a side effect, not the reason.

choices.text: Each run starts from empty
choices.why: Right, and memory is faster.

prompt: With a wrong password in `DATABASE_URL`, what exit status did `docker compose run --rm tests` give?
Why does a plain `go test ./...` not run `TestPostgresServesTheSeededCatalogue`?

choices.text: It is behind the `integration` build tag
choices.why: Right: `-tags integration` includes it.

choices.text: Go skips tests that need the network
choices.why: Go knows nothing about what a test needs.

choices.text: It fails silently without `DATABASE_URL`
choices.why: It fails loudly, by design.

choices.text: Only Compose can run it
choices.why: Anything that sets the tag and the variable can.

prompt: Which order of steps fits a pipeline for `shelf`, from this lesson?
hint: Fast failures first, the image last.

choices.text: Push the image, then run the tests against it
choices.why: An image that fails its tests should never be pushed.

choices.text: Test stage, integration run, then build and push
choices.why: Right: each step only runs if the one before passed.

choices.text: Integration tests only, since they cover everything
choices.why: Unit tests are faster and fail first.

choices.text: Build the image, then decide whether tests are needed
choices.why: Tests are what decide whether the image is built.
